reviewer: Kimi actual visual comparison of exact native source, enlarged source page, complete unchanged native RGBA, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged mascot reference

entries.positive_observation: Brown aviator cap with forehead goggles, swept light-blond/light-brown temple hair and light-brown eyebrows are retained. The previous invented pointed blond chin beard is absent: the chin is smooth with no moustache or beard. One calm closed mouth, direct gaze, frontal bust, brown leather coat, broad dark collar and close-wrapped red scarf match the visible source. The rounded chin meets the scarf/collar through a short broad transition without a stalk, floating collar or cream bib. Full white/cyan comparisons show no visible matte halo, smoky retained backing, internal holes or see-through cloth; dark pixels in the transparency preview were not treated as proof of a backing defect without the matte comparisons.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept native RGBA extrema0..254 with a genuine transparent exterior and no visible interior holes. Near-opacity values252..254 are not by themselves a rejection. No source-alpha replacement was performed or needed.
entries.visible_limitations: Fine goggle hardware and small coat fasteners remain unresolved at 42x46; no extra hardware or microscopic match is claimed.
